Hymn 117: Come unto Jesus
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: B-flat Major
Composer: Orson Pratt Huish
Lyricist/Text Author: Orson Pratt Huish
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 117 titled "Come unto Jesus" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Orson Pratt Huish and the lyrics were written by Orson Pratt Huish.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
